overall: The AG found the committee violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating by email among a quorum on a letter-to-the-editor; the committee had already acknowledged the error, and the AG ordered future compliance and release of the emails.

allegations.summary: Chair emailed the other committee members drafts of a letter-to-the-editor and asked whether they wanted their names attached, allegedly deliberating outside a posted meeting.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law.
Public release of the emails in question within 30 days of receipt of this determination, if the Committee has not already done so.
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and order the public release of the emails in question within 30 days of receipt of this determination, if the Committee has not already done so.
